notes.title: Major update: 1-turn kill
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205460/74dd69d604aed34c0b046ea9e5e43d2153707a63.png"]

The new Alpha demo will be available only between 25-31 August. 

So try it out fast or you'll have to wait for the next open window!


"1-turn kill" full focus


Previously the game was designed as a potential base building / wargame multiplayer.

Now we go all in on the single player roguelike brokenness which is what makes us unique!


💥 "On a knife's edge" game balance
New passive system (Traits) = whole faction blanket upgrades

Major cost reduction for super speedy deployment

Brokenness can be reach by default with in-game building upgrades (like a tech tree)

More than 1 reward per location possible, especially high risk/reward paths

Last few battles can win in less than 5 turns! (feels impossible, challenging but doable!)


⭐ Onboarding experience revamp
10-20 min max to finish the tutorial

Help player "get" the game brokenness immediately

Separate tutorial out from the campaign to replay

More in-context tutorial images

Gentler difficulty ramping up for player

Feeling of progression is strong and clear

Less story images


Next step
More visual effects for game feel feedback

Full UI revamp

Environment art upgrades



See you at our demo and feedback. Thanks!

Ahsaurus team 🤘
